claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GR-159897 is a potent, selective non-peptide NK2 (TACR2) tachykinin receptor antagonist with no intrinsic agonist activity; at 2.5 uM it is unlikely to kill cells broadly, and any antiproliferative effect would be weak and restricted to lines expressing NK2R, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
